blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutor Rep. Leila de Lima is expected to represent the prosecution panel during Wednesday’s oral arguments on how to interpret the two-thirds threshold required by the Constitution to convict an impeached official. “I understand that it will be Congresswoman Leila de Lima,” House prosecutor Rep. Chel Diokno said in an interview over “Bantay Balita sa Kongreso,” a DZBB AM radio program anchored by Nimfa Ravelo and Isa Avendaño-Umali. The prosecution will definitely take a position on the issue, but ultimately, the impeachment court will decide on the issue, Diokno stressed. The oral arguments are expected to clarify […]...
